text:
maria: heads-up — seeing a cluster of intermittent ECC/Xid spikes on g2 racks after a heavy job ramp in us-west-2. not consistent per-card but correlated with long seq-len workloads. want to propose a quickturn "thermal-surge" soak workflow before we put nodes back in rotation. thoughts?
ajay: ack. can you paste the last dmesg slice? curious if it's ECC single-bit or something escalating to Xid 79/62. also want to know if PCIe resets drop the error count.
maria: pasted log below:
``
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, pid=2145, GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 12346.000123] kernel: GPU ECC single-bit corrected at mem+0x1a3f
```
kevin: ok. propose this mini-playbook: run 6h quickturn with thermal cycling + synthetic seq-len 4096 workload, then 24h soak if it reproduces. automation:
``
soak-runner --mode thermal-surge --duration 6h --workload seq4096 --pci-reset-after 30m --report-to #eng-infra
```
soak-runner-bot: started soak job id=sr-20260312-01 on node=g2-07 rack-33, ETA 6h. logs pushing to s3://soak-logs/us-west-2/sr-20260312-01
noah: threshold suggestion: if Xid >= 2 or corrected ECC > 5 within 6h -> quarantine + full memtest and kernel-module pin. otherwise rotate back. also factor in regional capacity: us-west-2 is tight this week — we should *prefer* to escalate to replace only on repeated failures.
maria: cost question — losing a node for 24h soak instead of immediate replace: estimate?
kevin: rough calc: reserved capacity cost avoided vs time-to-replace. losing node for 24h ~ $25 in infra credits but replacement + data migration + SLA risk could be ~$300+ depending on dedicated workloads. quick soak often cheaper if it catches intermittent flaky silicon.
ajay: add to workflow: if soak reproduces Xid, run this sequence before RMA: 1) full memtest86 2) nvme firmware check 3) PCIe lane toggle via `pcie_retrain.sh` 4) driver downgrade to kernel-6.3-stable for 24h. record telemetry: temp, vpc, pcierr.
maria: noted. i'll queue the soak job and set the gating rule: >2 Xid in 6h -> auto-drain and label node=quarantine. will post link when job starts. :eyes:
ops-bot: node g2-07 drained by ops-bot (soak run) — channels notified.
maria: thanks — will update thread with final verdict. anyone want to pair on the memtest script?
noah: I'll help at 13:00 PT.
maria: perfect, thanks team :thumbsup:
